TABLE.NAME: local_coursesoverview_order
TABLE.COMMENT: One customer order: the course that was created for it and how its credentials go out.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Empty until the course has been created, and again once it has been deleted.

FIELD.NAME: module
FIELD.COMMENT: Prefix of the module as configured in the settings.

FIELD.NAME: shortname
FIELD.COMMENT: Kept separately so that the order stays readable after the course is gone.

FIELD.NAME: emailpattern
FIELD.COMMENT: How the customer's addresses are built, kept for the people it reports late. Empty when nobody said.

FIELD.NAME: senddate
FIELD.COMMENT: When the credentials are due. Zero means they went out while the order was created.

FIELD.NAME: timefrozen
FIELD.COMMENT: When the course was about to be deleted and its final numbers were kept. Zero while it exists.

FIELD.NAME: finaltotal
FIELD.COMMENT: People the course tracked for completion just before it was deleted.

FIELD.NAME: finalcompleted
FIELD.COMMENT: Of those, how many had completed it. Empty when completion was off.

INDEX.NAME: senddate-timesent
INDEX.COMMENT: Read by the task that mails the credentials.

TABLE.NAME: local_coursesoverview_orderuser
TABLE.COMMENT: Who belongs to an order, and whether their credentials have gone out.

FIELD.NAME: reused
FIELD.COMMENT: The account already existed and was deliberately used again instead of being created.

FIELD.NAME: delivery
FIELD.COMMENT: How this person's credentials go out. People reported late may get theirs differently from the original order.

FIELD.NAME: senddate
FIELD.COMMENT: When the task mails the credentials. Zero means the task has nothing to do for this person.

INDEX.NAME: senddate-timesent
INDEX.COMMENT: Read by the task that mails the credentials.
